description.value:
Cybersuite · Neuralware, Hospital, HL 7 (2d6), 1 Neural Link slot. Requires a Neuroport. Installs one Cyberdeck inside your Neuroport, Hardware slots and all: 20m to architectures, 50m to Neuroports and vehicles. Swapping the deck is a Clinic job (1 hour).

Built-in quickhacks (take no deck slots, can't be removed): Puppet, Synapse Burnout, Total System Kill

+2 on the first quickhack against a target while you're undetected in the NET and meatspace. Owning one is a death sentence if Arasaka finds out.

Not for sale.
